items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And that's when I went up to join Art Bronson and His Bostonians.

ctx.x: too many people. I was supposed to have some kind of cousin out there or something, but I never did find him. But anyway, they went to Denver, and about a week later I got a ticket to come on up to Denver.

And that's when I went up to join Art Bronson and His Bostonians. I don't think nobody in there had ever been to Boston!, ha-ha, now that I think about it, you know. But they was a nice group, you know. Prez wasn't there. I wish he had've been; I'd love to have been there when he was there!
But anyway, I stayed with them for a while, and then Harriet Calloway came through Denver. Have you ever heard of her?
